Does anyone prefer the old seasons to the new seasons or vice versa. I noticed that in the new season the show has a tendency to animate inanimate objects like the toilet and to also become surreal. Personally, I enjoy the humor more in the earlier seasons. The newer episodes have a few shining moments as well, but a lot of the show's dynamics changed entirely. For example, the characters became flanderized and the plotlines all basically revolve around either 1. Spongebob working 2. Spongebob annoying squidward 3. Spongebob jellyfishing.

So really, a lot of it has been slimmed down to a one dimensional kind of plot. That's a big issue with modern spongebob and it all follows a pretty rigid formula. However, season 9 has been redeeming in degrees of humor so I think with season 10 and Hillenburg returning, things will take a turn for the better.
